sequences.cfg:
r_csgo_postprocess_enable 0
mirv_campath enabled 0
mirv_campath clear
mirv_campath load "{REPO}/videos/campaths/broll-c1-p4-clip1.xml"
mirv_campath offset none
mirv_campath enabled 1
mirv_cmd clear
mirv_cmd addAtTick 2744 mirv_campath offset current
mirv_cmd addAtTick 3571 mirv_campath enabled 0
r_drawviewmodel 0
cl_drawhud 0
mirv_cmd addAtTick 3571 cl_drawhud 1
mirv_cmd addAtTick 2722 spec_mode 3
mirv_streams settings add sampler csdvBlur1
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 settings csdmPreset1
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 fps 60
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 exposure 0.5
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 strength 1.0
mirv_streams record screen settings csdvBlur1
mirv_streams record fps 240
